name: sqlite3
description: SQLite is a software library that implements a self-contained, serverless, zero-configuration, transactional SQL database engine.

cfg-mem-mgmt.description: Adds extra logic to SQLite that allows it to release unused memory upon request

cfg-memsys5.description: Includes code in SQLite that implements an alternative memory allocator, version 5

ext-sqlite-vec.description: Adds sqlite-vec (external) extension (no-op, embedded into amalgamation)

fact-preupdate-hook.description: Enables API for rowid changes hook

feat-atomic-write.description: Enables atomic page writes if supported by a target filesystem

feat-batch-atomic-write.description: Enables batched atomic page writes if supported by a target filesystem

feat-column-metadata.description: Enables API of access to metadata about tables and queries

feat-like-dontmatch-blob.description: Disables LIKE to work over BLOBs

feat-omit-deprecated.description: Perf: Omits deprecated interfaces and features

feat-omit-shared-cache.description: Perf: Disables shared cache between db connections

feat-session.description: Enables sesssion mechanism to record cumulative table changes

feat-stat4.description: Enables query planner and ANALYZE additional logic

feat-update-delete-limit.description: Enables ORDER BY and LIMIT clause on UPDATE and DELETE statements

feat-vtab-bytecode.description: Enables virtual tables with prepared statemens metadata

feat-vtab-dbpage.description: Enables virtual table interface to direct db file pages operations

feat-vtab-dbstat.description: Enables virtual table with disk space usage metadata

feat-vtab-statement.description: Enables virtual table with db connection metadata
